thread:
deploy-bot: [AUTO-ROLLBACK] Release 3.7.2 -> rollback to 3.7.1 initiated. Trigger: p95 latency > 1200ms (5m) + error-rate spike > 3%. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/rollback.

maya: Wait — I'm seeing a regression in a canary test that looks unrelated. Can we pause auto-rollback for 5m while I validate traces?

liam: Pausing risks more customer errors. If we're manual, I vote for immediate manual promote to 3.7.0 (known good) instead of 3.7.1. 3.7.1 had the KV-cache flip.

carla: Confirmed — 3.7.1 reintroduces kv-cache eviction bug under certain seq lengths. 3.7.0 is stable.

ops-oncall: If ops agrees we'll cancel the auto action and run a manual rollback. To cancel auto-rollback: `deployctl rollback cancel --release=3.7.2 --reason "investigating telemetry"`

ops-oncall: Manual rollback command (promote older release):
`deployctl promote --service=inference-api --to-version=3.7.0 --force --wait`

maya: I'll triage traces now and confirm whether the root cause is model compilation or runtime kernel selection. If it's compilation, might need a hotfix later.

liam: Also request: pin dedicated pools to avoid an immediate re-roll to 3.7.2 while we investigate. Example: `redwoodctl pin --pool=eu-dedicated --version=3.7.0`

carla: I'll update release notes + incident draft. Suggest short customer note: "We rolled back 3.7.2 due to elevated latency; stable version 3.7.0 restored. Investigating."

maya: +1 on the note. I'll attach traces and a short summary.

sre-rotation-bot: Oncall handover in 45m (2026-03-21 03:00Z). Please include current status in handover.

liam: ops-oncall, can you execute cancel + promote? I'll stand by to verify traffic and open alarms.

ops-oncall: Doing cancel now. `deployctl rollback cancel --release=3.7.2 --reason "manual hold for triage"`

ops-oncall: Cancel confirmed. Now promoting 3.7.0. `deployctl promote --service=inference-api --to-version=3.7.0 --force --wait`

deploy-bot: Promote started. Monitoring rollout. Traffic target set to 100% -> 3.7.0.

liam: I'm watching p50/p95 and error-rate dashboards. So far p95 trending down.

maya: Traces show high kernel compile time coincident with rollout. Likely a kernel selection change in 3.7.2. Saving artifacts to /tmp/rollout-traces-3319998888.tar.gz and linking to ticket #INF-1245.

carla: Drafted customer note and internal postmortem stub. Will post to #incidents once we confirm stable.

ops-oncall: Promote complete, traffic moved. All checks green after 2 mins. Closing rollback thread but will keep monitoring for 15m.

liam: :thumbsup: Good call to pin. Can we schedule a blocked deploy window for 3.7.2 reattempt until the kernel fix is verified?

maya: I'll coordinate with runtime team tomorrow AM and add a checklist for kernel-selection smoke tests before any re-roll.

carla: I'll send the customer note in 10 mins after a final health check.

sre-rotation-bot: Reminder: handover updated with current actions.

liam: Thanks everyone. Closing here once customer note is posted.

carla: customer note posted: "We rolled back 3.7.2 and restored 3.7.0 due to latency spike; investigation ongoing. We'll share an update within 24 hours." :white_check_mark:
